description:
Create, list and show thread files at threads/<Kind>/<Name>.md (Kind: Projects, Processes or Topics).

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list threads (open only by default); QUERY ranks by fuzzy similarity
  show THREAD [--json] — show one thread file
  new --name NAME --kind KIND --category CATEGORY [--currency CODE] [--rate N] — create a thread file

Flags:
  list:
    --all   include paused and closed threads
    --json  JSON output
  show:
    THREAD  thread name or 'Kind/Name'
    --json  JSON output
  new:
    --name NAME          required; becomes the filename; no '/' and no leading '.'
    --kind KIND          required; project, process or topic (files under Projects, Processes, Topics)
    --category CATEGORY  required; professional, personal or voluntary
    --currency CODE      default 3-letter ISO currency for hours; without it the thread is unbilled
    --rate N             default hourly rate for hours; needs --currency

Examples:
  ["list", "northwind", "--json"]
  ["show", "Projects/Northwind"]
  ["new", "--name", "Northwind", "--kind", "project", "--category", "professional", "--currency", "ZAR", "--rate", "1500"]

Notes:
  There is no delete or close subcommand. To close a thread, set status: closed and ended: in its frontmatter; nothing moves.
  Nothing prompts.
  Exit 1: empty name, name with '/' or a leading '.', thread already exists, --rate without --currency.
